title: Guided reading · round 1 (DRAFT)
intro: DRAFT, 26 Nov: drawn by the agent, not by Claude Design. The Chrome extension was not connected, so the designer was not reached. The canvas “Clubmate · guided reading” is seeded (language boards, today's question card shot, these boards on page r1) and the brief is in prompt.md, ready for the real round.

Five new SDUI components for guided code reading (backlog #1294, #1295), in build order 1 → 2+3 → 4 → 5. They live in the Agents transcript of a graph node session, next to today's question card. Mac first; iPhone and iPad for 1–3.

1 · Line pick: A gutter pick in the card (drawer's pick), B lettered candidate lines, C pick in nvim. 2 · Reveal: A in place (pick), B separate verdict card. 3 · Confidence: chips + Send (pick), or C “the chip sends”. 4 + 5: A button row under the step + map strip under the header (pick), B Show me + More menu + map in the Context panel.

boards.caption: A: free pick in the card, j/k and ↩, range with ⇧. B: one key per candidate line, gives part of the answer away. C: pick with the real cursor in nvim, ,q sends.
